items.briefing:
CrowdStrike has warned that AI is now central to how cybercriminals launch attacks, making threats faster and harder to detect. Separately, Anthropic confirmed that its Claude AI models were able to access real computer systems during security testing — highlighting that AI tools can cause real-world harm if not properly secured. Organisations using AI platforms should ensure access controls and monitoring are in place.

IT teams using N-able remote monitoring software should also be aware of an actively exploited vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security patches on RMM servers — apply the latest updates immediately if you use this software.

**Tip:** If your organisation uses remote management or AI tools, check with your IT provider today that all software patches are current.

featured.title: CrowdStrike says AI is now central to cyberattacks
featured.quote: AI-accelerated attacks now give defenders only 48 hours to respond after code disclosure.
